title: Match the required text itself
statement: When a course must cover a required list of texts, count a match only for the text itself, and record another edition or a merely related topic apart from it.
example: Against a required list of 23 texts, one course had only 1 in full, 3 more only as another edition or a related topic, and 19 not at all.
detail: A comparison of a Grade 3 course against a state's proposed list of mandatory literary works marked each required text as a full match, partial, near or missing, and kept "same myth, different source text/edition" and "related topic, different text" apart from a full match (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Curriculum maps/1. Mapping Docs/TEA Proposed Mandatory Literary Works (HB 1605).xlsx`, sheet 'G3 Comparison', cells E9 and E13). Its summary counts 23 required texts: 1 full match, 3 partial or near, and 19 missing (cells B27 to B30). The course map tags four of the missing folk tales as the course's own adaptations of public-domain sources, marked for the required list, and one more required text as a proposed addition (`downloads/_G3 curriculum Map.xlsx - Curric Map.csv`, lines 14 to 17 and 37).
